summary: The checker report is clean (P-0 to P-13 ok) and every Handover requirement line reads met: waitress debt, driver cash, guard regulars 16 of 16, keeper's 18 needs, row caps. Names are mixed with no era. Fit fails, which the checker cannot see. The one guard routine sends the 01:30 watch guard to the café while it is closed (it opens 6 to 24). The kiosk tram routines bring the 05:00 attendants in before the first service. Open question: does Help refuse a fearful driver or server? Casting found Help not refused.

faults.fault: The guards have one routine, guard-cafe-square (preShift cafe), and the note says it covers the watch too. The watch works 17:30-01:30 and 01:30-09:30. A guard on the 01:30 shift would stop at the café at about 01:20, but the diner is open 6–24, so that stop cannot happen in the unit's hours. No server is on shift then, so the pre-shift regular tie has no one to be aimed at.
faults.fix: Add a second guard variant for the 01:30 watch with preShift none and positions guard, or limit the café variant to the office and 17:30 shifts. Keep at least half of all guards on a preShift: cafe variant with regular ties to the café staff.

faults.fault: The variants skyrail-tram (35%) and tramkiosk-tram (35%) put kiosk attendants on the tram. Stations run 5:00-1:00 and the first kiosk shift starts at 05:00, so a tram commuter on that shift would arrive before the first service. Those routines cannot happen in the station's hours.
faults.fix: Make the 05:00 kiosk shift walk-only: restrict the tram variant so it does not cover that shift, or give the kiosk rows walk commutes only.
